title: Part of a program shut down as 'demonic technology'

tellings.quote: had people actually shut down a piece of a program on the basis that american taxpayer dollars should not be spent on pursuing demonic technology

plain: Part of a secret US government research programme was once shut down because some people felt American taxpayers' money should not pay for chasing "demonic technology". The physicist Hal Puthoff, who has worked on government studies of unexplained phenomena, says this on Michels's show from his own experience inside the work. He does not say which programme it was or when it happened, but if true it would mean religious objections have shaped what the government is willing to study.
